title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A closing parenthesis on its own line
summary: The stop added in 1.42.92 ended the header at any line beginning with a parenthesis. Kotlin also lets the supertype list lead the line after it, and those supertypes were dropped without a sound.

highlights.title: The list may start the next line
highlights.description: class Foo(...) then a line beginning with a colon and the supertypes is valid Kotlin, and the class was read as having none.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A constructor closing on a bare parenthesis no longer ends the header. Only the very next non blank line may carry the supertype list, which keeps the fix from reaching a colon that belongs to something further down: the 50 supertypes wrongly taken from a method return type on a real Android project are still refused.
